| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Spatial sigma** `sigmaSpatial` | 8 | 2 to 64 px | The cell size of the grid in x and y. Pixels further apart than this rarely share a vertex. |
| **Brightness sigma** `sigmaLuma` | 16 | 2 to 64 | The cell size of the grid in brightness Y, in levels. |
| **Color sigma** `sigmaChroma` | 16 | 2 to 64 | The cell size of the grid in Cb and Cr, in levels. |
| **Smoothness lambda** `lambda` | 128 | 0 to 1024 | The weight of smoothness against closeness to the input. |
